name: A Big Family in Debt
source: You will be playing as a normal 19-year-old boy with classic problems whose desire is just to have fun. No girlfriend, no job and school situation is gross. Your family is deciding whether to keep you at home or transfer to the hateful Orlando Catholic Institute. Make sure that this will never happen.​
translation: 你将扮演一个普通的19岁男孩，面临着经典问题，他的愿望只是获得乐趣。没有女朋友，没有工作，学校的情况很糟糕。你的家人正在决定是让你留在家里还是转学到可恶的奥兰多天主教学院。确保这永远不会发生。​
